minimal_justified_feature_set.source_variable: step.scenario_slice[arrival, service_id, input_size, cpu_cycles, positions_xy] + context.local_cache + cache_nodes
minimal_justified_feature_set.suggested_dimension: per cache head and service; request mass, input-bit workload and CPU-cycle workload channels, aggregated by predicted serviceability and optionally local-cache hit
minimal_justified_feature_set.DIRECT_VALUE_PATH: Forecast service opportunities change whether a newly cached service creates an edge target; input/cycles change Matching/KKT, delay, energy and utility; local cache changes feasible targets.

minimal_justified_feature_set.suggested_dimension: candidate count plus candidate-policy-weighted per-service target/demand/usage deltas and scalar loaded-MB/cache-cost/capacity/replica summary
minimal_justified_feature_set.DIRECT_VALUE_PATH: Target controls updated services and next state; additions and eta/xi determine direct cache cost; candidate distribution defines the conditional UPDATE outcome. Uses forecast/catalog/state only, not exact Q/reward.

TIER_B_PLAUSIBLE_BUT_INDIRECT: Separate raw service catalog constants: their state-dependent size/workload effects can be represented in the two summaries.
Separate fixed per-head CPU/bandwidth/tx-power fields: role/head/config already fixes them and they are not dynamic state.
Fine-grained predicted link-rate margin: derivable proxy but less minimal/direct than node-local workload and candidate summary.
REJECTED_NOT_JUSTIFIED: actual_tasks, realized task fields, matching/KKT outputs, delay, energy, reward and branch Q
raw future task draw instead of forecast expectations
duplicate global cache bits, predicted coordinates/popularity, or fixed head/role identity

final.resource_state_note: Resource-state missing refers to forecast node/service workload and candidate storage/capacity/load summaries. Fixed role CPU, bandwidth and tx-power are determined by head/role/config and are not dynamic per-slot state.
